kind: PROSPECTIVE CONFIRMATION (research only; no bets, recommendations, SIFT badges, staking or automatic wagers)

wave1_provenance.frozen_context_moderate_control_ats: n 1,834, 921-869-44, 51.5% cover, ROI -1.8%: NO ATS EDGE. Not reopened.

population.no_backfill: Only games whose OBSERVATION row was appended by the research conductor strictly before the checkpoint window closed (kickoff-60 min). A game kicking off on/after the activation instant with no observation by then is recorded as SYSTEM_FAILURE, never reconstructed later.
population.game_identity: Kalshi game key from the production market catalog; ESPN event id from the production frozen V2 artifact (content.event_id); home/away and team ids from the ESPN schedule event. Unresolvable -> IDENTITY_FAILURE.

checkpoint.rule: The checkpoint snapshot is the LAST capture attempt inside the window whose oriented ladder yields a market_implied_margin. Nothing outside the window is ever searched. No such capture -> ENTRY_UNAVAILABLE (or MARKET_NOT_OFFERED / ORIENTATION_FAILURE / SYSTEM_FAILURE when that is the reason).

market_center.name: market_implied_margin
market_center.algorithm: Wave-1 scripts/signal_discovery_cfb_kalshi_2026_spread.py, unchanged arithmetic. For perspective team T: every KXNCAAFSPREAD rung '<team> wins by over s' with status active/open and 0 < yes_bid <= yes_ask < 1 gives mid = (yes_bid + yes_ask)/2. A rung of T gives the point (s, mid); a rung of T's opponent gives the point (-s, 1 - mid). Points are sorted ascending (strike, then probability). market_implied_margin = s1 + (p1 - 0.5)/(p1 - p2) * (s2 - s1) at the FIRST consecutive pair with p1 >= 0.5 >= p2 and p1 != p2. No crossing -> None (missing stays missing). The final score is never read.
market_center.orientation: A spread rung's team code is its ticker suffix with the trailing integer (floor_strike + 0.5) removed. The code is mapped to an ESPN team id through the frozen production matcher control_market.quotes.orient_markets applied to the SAME game's captured KXNCAAFGAME markets (<event>-<CODE>). Both ladder codes must map to the two different competitors of the game's ESPN event, else ORIENTATION_FAILURE.
market_center.report: rungs used (all points, the bracketing pair), snapshot captured_at, minutes before kickoff

contract.name: natural rung (deterministic; never optimised)
contract.rule: Among the side-perspective ladder points of the checkpoint snapshot, the point with the smallest |p - 0.5|; ties broken by smaller |s|, then by ticker. A point from the side's own rung is bought as YES at the captured yes_ask; a point from the opponent's rung is bought as NO at the captured no_ask. NO is never 1 - YES. An ask that is not a whole cent in [1, 99] -> economics unavailable (QUOTE_NOT_EXECUTABLE); no other rung is substituted.
contract.pays: YES on '<side> wins by over s' pays iff side margin > s; NO on '<opponent> wins by over s' pays iff opponent margin <= s. Strikes are half-points: no push.
contract.fee: kalshi.fee_schedule.calculate_fee_cents(price_cents, 1, KALSHI_FEE_SCHEDULE_2026_07_07_TAKER, get_taker_multiplier('KXNCAAFSPREAD')), taker, at the entry ask. Uncomputable -> FEE_UNAVAILABLE, never 0.
contract.units: one research contract; no stake, no sizing

settlement.source: production game log data/football/<season>/team_games.jsonl (ESPN final score), read only after kickoff
settlement.ats_like: WIN if residual > 0, LOSS if residual < 0, PUSH if exactly 0 (excluded from the rate)
settlement.append_only: Settlement is a new SETTLEMENT row; frozen OBSERVATION and ENTRY rows are never mutated.
settlement.closing_context: the last capture with 0 < minutes_before < 60 yielding a market_implied_margin; side-aware closing move = closing implied margin - entry implied margin (positive = moved toward the side). Contract CLV = the same ticker's same-side ask at that capture - entry ask. Missing stays missing.

CFB-PROS-001.name: RUSHING_EDGE_SPREAD
CFB-PROS-001.wording: An opponent-adjusted rushing / rush-defense quality edge of at least the Wave-1 frozen qualifying magnitude produces a positive realized margin residual relative to the pre-registered Kalshi spread-market expectation.
CFB-PROS-001.wave1_source: CFB-DSC-001 (set 2, Holm-surviving, block B +0.69 pts/SD, 12/12 seasons) with its pre-registered follow rule
CFB-PROS-001.feature: defdiff.rush_success_rate = home_def_q.rush_success_rate - away_def_q.rush_success_rate (signal_discovery.evaluate._derive_set2), from signal_discovery.features.pregame_features on the production game log at the production 04:00 ET data cutoff
CFB-PROS-001.side: home if z > 0, away if z < 0 (expected_sign +1)
CFB-PROS-001.feature_eligibility: signal_discovery.features.eligibility(row) is None and the feature is defined
CFB-PROS-001.descriptive_only: CFB-SIG-015 net.rushing is recorded on the observation for description; it never selects games
CFB-PROS-001.falsified: mean residual <= 0 at n >= 400 settled -> REJECTED. Economics are judged separately and never rescue or reject the residual question.

CFB-PROS-002.name: STRONG_CONTROL_MARKET_SKEPTICISM
CFB-PROS-002.wording: STRONG CONTROL games in which the pre-registered Kalshi spread-ladder market expectation assigns the CONTROL side an implied margin below +3 points outperform that market expectation prospectively.
CFB-PROS-002.control_source: the first production V2 FINAL_PREGAME ledger row (methodology control-v2) for the game seen by the conductor before the window closes; CONTROL tier/side copied verbatim, never recomputed
CFB-PROS-002.eligibility: CONTROL exists, strength STRONG, CONTROL side known, valid PRIMARY_60_180 ladder, market_implied_margin(CONTROL side) < 3.0 (strict)
CFB-PROS-002.falsified: ATS-like success rate < 52% at n >= 100 settled -> REJECTED (descriptive falsification threshold)

verdict_rule: n settled below the first read -> PROSPECTIVE_TRACKING; at/after a read -> that read's state; at/after PRIMARY_REVIEW n: falsified -> REJECTED, otherwise REVIEW_REQUIRED (a human decides; nothing is promoted by code).

statistics.intervals: 95% bootstrap percentile, 4,000 resamples, numpy default_rng(20261010); Wilson 95% for rates
statistics.empty: NO SETTLED SAMPLE (n 0 is never shown as a 0 rate or 0 ROI)
